title: Spectra — Fourier Lab
description: A six-mode interactive Fourier lab on a from-scratch FFT: draw shapes redrawn by rotating vectors, build and HEAR spectra, filter noise in the frequency domain (A/B audio), read spectrograms, compare a Morlet wavelet scalogram against the STFT, and paint masks over a real 2-D image FFT. Deep-linkable; no math libraries.
